summary.text: Nicole Leapley is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 22 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Leapley is an educator with a Ph.D. in French literature, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Nicole Leapley was born in Nebraska.
She earned a B.A. from the University of Nebraska in 1997, an M.A. from the University of Pennsylvania in 2000 and a Ph.D. in French literature from the University of Pennsylvania in 2003.
Leapley won the Hillsborough 22 general elections on November 8, 2022 and November 5, 2024.
Her 2023-2024 committee assignment was the House Ways and Means Committee.
